legacy_record.description: A private source row retained for migration reconciliation and customer-link continuity. It never schedules generation, mail or fulfillment.

legacy_asset.description: A verified copy of a source attachment, linked to its original book, page or free printable.

legacy_page.description: The digest of an existing free-printable capability; it opens only that printable.

legacy_opt_out.description: The digest of an existing unsubscribe capability, preserving suppression without sending a message.
